subject: RccpEigen dependency thwarts shiny app deployment.

messages.author: 0a07b9c43d30a76f
messages.subject: RccpEigen dependency thwarts shiny app deployment.
parts:
when attempting to deploy a shiny app that uses the caret package and functions perfectly locally, I received the following message: Application depends on package "RccpEigen" but it is not installed. Please resolve before continuing. Adding a 'require('RccpEigen')' to shiny server does not resolve this. When I attempt to install the package locally, I receive " Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘RccpEigen’ is not available (for R version 3.1.2)". Thoughts on how to resolve?
>

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] RccpEigen dependency thwarts shiny app deployment.
parts:

believe you must have this typo somewhere in your app.
